title: Withholding Tax Defaults: Mitigating Section 234E Fees & TRACES Corrections
summary: Handling quarterly e-TDS returns (24Q, 26Q), Section 194T/194C rates, TRACES revisions, and Form 26QB property sale deductions.
body:
Failure to deposit tax deducted at source or submit quarterly returns triggers daily financial penalties.

Statutory Penalty Provisions:
1. Section 234E: Daily late fee of ₹200 for each day of filing default (capped at total deduction).
2. Section 201(1A): Penal interest @ 1.5% per month for non-deposit of collected TDS.
3. Section 271H: Penalty ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000 for prolonged defaults.

Learn how to revise TDS returns online on TRACES and manage Section 194C/194T compliance. For assistance with quarterly TDS filings, visit our [Corporate Compliance Desk](/compliance).
